# Package URL (purl)

Package URL is [spec](https://github.com/package-url/purl-spec) that tries
to standardize the format of package identifiers. The specifications of
purls for different packages, like npm and Github packages, can be found
[here](https://github.com/package-url/purl-spec/blob/master/PURL-TYPES.rst).

The TMA currently uses purls as an unique identifier for npm package
releases. It can be generalized for other types of packages if
eventually supported by the TMA.
